subject: Post-call recap: Solenex discovery + exec next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@solenex.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 16:10:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap: Solenex discovery + exec next steps

Jordan — thanks for the time today. Quick written recap from our call so we have alignment and a clear next steps list. Please reply with any corrections.

High-level summary
- Business outcome: Solenex wants to embed advanced retrieval-augmented generation across their support and knowledge workflows to reduce average handle time and deflection by ~15-25% and to improve first-contact resolution.
- Primary pain points discussed:
  - Latency and scale: current infra spikes cause inconsistent response times; target for pilot is median latency <= 120ms and p95 < 400ms under expected load.
  - Cost unpredictability: current token spend has variable bursts; they want more predictable per-query economics.
  - Security & compliance: SOC 2 evidence, network topology and data residency are gating items for procurement.

Goals we heard
- Run a 6–8 week pilot focused on support use cases (chat + summarization) starting mid-April.
- Demonstrate 50% reduction in average response latency for common queries and validate cost-per-session assumptions.
- Get sign-off from IT/security and procurement with a path to PO/contract for H2 production.

Procurement path & timeline (as discussed)
- Solenex will run vendor risk review + security questionnaire (IT/security).
- Procurement requires SOC2 Type II and a vendor network diagram; they prefer a PO after pilot.
- Target: Pilot sign-off and PO decision by end of Q2 (June 2027).

Open risks / escalation items
- SOC2 evidence: need to deliver SOC2 Type II report and brief security summary quickly to avoid blocking IT review.
- Dedicated environment: they may require a dedicated deployment (VPC/dedicated GPUs) to meet data segregation requirements — this could change pricing and capacity commitments.
- Contract terms: IP/data use language and SLAs may need legal review and potential escalation.

Next steps (owners & dates)
1) Marissa (Redwood) — Send pilot plan + SOW draft and a short security summary (attached). Target: Mon 2027-03-29. [attachment: redwood-pilot-plan.pdf]
2) Jordan (Solenex) — Share vendor risk questionnaire and confirm security contact & procurement timeline. Target: Tue 2027-03-30.
3) Marissa/Laura — Prep exec one-pager (business outcomes & ask) for Solenex leadership if procurement requests a sponsor-level note. Target: Fri 2027-04-02.
4) Both — Schedule a 30-min exec sync the week of 2027-04-12 to align pilots and commitments.

Attachments: redwood-pilot-plan.pdf (pilot milestones, measurement plan), SOW-draft.docx (high-level commercial terms)

Thanks again — happy to hop back on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Cc: Priya Patel <priya.patel@solenex.io>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Solenex discovery + exec next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear write-up; this matches our discussion. A few quick notes from our side:

- Procurement & security: Priya (copied) is our procurement sponsor; she confirms vendor risk review will run next week. IT/security will require a SOC2 Type II report and a network diagram. Can you send the SOC2 summary and a one-page network diagram?
- Pilot length: Our preferred pilot is 6–8 weeks, but procurement has suggested a 60-day timeline to make it easier to budget. Either works for us as long as milestones are clear.
- Dedicated env: We are likely to require a VPC/dedicated instance for the pilot; please flag commercial/pricing impact.
- Budget owner: Finance will evaluate pilot cost against the FY27 support automation budget; expect a final decision post-pilot for production funding.

Action items from me: I will 1) share the vendor questionnaire by EOD Mon 2027-03-29, and 2) confirm our IT security contact and preferred evidence format.

Looks good to move forward. I also think an exec-level note to our COO will help expedite procurement if we can get a short one-pager.

Jordan

Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap: Solenex discovery + exec next steps — Exec summary

Laura / Sean — forwarding the thread with Jordan (external). High-level exec summary and asks below so leadership has the context and we can align on any needed escalations.

Executive summary (for leadership)
- Customer: Solenex (mid-market; support-centered product org). Potential ARR if productionized: $400–600k/year.
- Outcome: Reduce support handle time and increase resolution rate by leveraging Redwood’s low-latency RAG. Expected business impact: 10–20% lower support cost and faster time-to-resolution.
- Why now: Solenex has a clear runway to commit budget in H2; procurement is asking for SOC2 evidence and a path to a PO after an initial pilot.

Key risks that may require escalation
1) Security evidence: SOC2 Type II and network diagram needed quickly. If we can’t provide acceptable evidence within 7–10 business days, IT will block.
2) Dedicated deployment request: If Solenex insists on dedicated VPC/GPU allocation for pilot, we’ll need to confirm capacity and pricing — may require approval from head of revenue/ops for any one-off credits or minimum commitments.
3) Contract terms: Any non-standard IP/data language or restrictive SLAs will require legal time; we may need to offer an interim pilot agreement to keep momentum.

Asks
- Laura: please review the attached pilot plan and confirm if we can offer a VPC/dedicated pilot profile and the expected cost delta.
- Sean: please put a placeholder for a dedicated >2 GPU pilot slot the week of 2027-04-12 and advise on change window/ops support.
- Both: if there’s any reason to escalate to VP Sales / Head of Product for discount or capacity prioritization, let me know — Jordan asked for a short exec note to their COO which could speed procurement.

Attachments: Solenex-Pilot-Plan.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf

Thanks — I’ll coordinate legal and security ping if we need a faster turnaround on evidence.

Best,
Marissa Cole
